scope: Every listed original was separately viewed at original dimensions and matched to its immutable same-package SHA-256. Six legacy filenames say light but their actual images are dark, so they count only as dark evidence. Retry and second-page images do not show lower outcomes or footer; native assertions remain separate. This does not establish every list row, independent repository/session loading, all Windows DPI, installed visuals or complete reference adoption.
